notes: All 62 distinct FBbt terms across 184 mapped clusters verified current/non-obsolete/label-match against FBbt 2026-06-11 via scripts/verify_mappings.py. Deterministic steps (annotations, 124 placeholders, collate) reproduce byte-identically from current code; the 8 pilot clusters were re-run under current agent guidance with 0 changes in FBbt assignment/match-type/flags. 12 class-C clusters held (class undefined). Sample/Assay/Clustering layer built from GEO (7 biological samples, 36 10x-library assays, 2 clusterings) with FBdv stages + FBbt tissue per curated timepoint map; FBdv 2026-04-02, FBcv 2026-04-03. Expression summary stats computed from the raw 10x matrix: CPM-normalised mean over expressing cells (level) + extent, filtered extent>0.2 -> 584,710 cluster x gene rows (expression.tsv + GSE156455_expression.owl.gz); total/filtered gene counts on each Cluster, and dataset-level total/filtered gene counts on the Dataset (union across clusters, matching the old repo's get_gene_counts). Sample sex set to female (from the paper; not annotated in GEO). FlyBase stock refs (FBst) for each sample resolved from FlyBase Chado and linked via BAO:0095000 'is derived from'; no free-text genotype slot. Publication linked to the VFB :pub node FBrf0247594 (checked in the VFB curation KB by PMID; config fallback used as it is not yet in the KB). Dataset carries site vfb:GEO (VFB Site node) with the GSE accession as the dbxref annotation. 2026-10-06 regeneration under the general curation rules: the main dataset already had one row per author cluster (the 196 subtype populations of the authors' clustering; `type` only groups them), so its clusters, mappings and ids are unchanged. Added the authors' separately clustered EARLY dataset (0-24h APF, GSE156455_metadata_early / matrix_early) as Clusters of the existing 'early' Clustering: 110 clusters labelled early_<cluster> (main clusters relabelled main_<cluster>, registry keys renamed so ids are unchanged) (28 named, mapped by map-clusters-to-fbbt subagents to immature FBbt terms, e.g. immature lamina monopolar neuron L1; 20 numbered N/G with stage-appropriate anchors - N: immature adult optic lobe neuron FBbt:00053539, G: glial cell FBbt:00005144 as FBbt has no immature optic-lobe glia term; 62 held: 58 class x (unresolved) + 4 class C). Old FlyBase/SCEA load FBlc0006237 crosswalked as a cross-check (prior_mapping_FBlc0006237.tsv): 183 of 184 comparable main clusters agree (R184 placeholder anchor eye photoreceptor cell vs old light-sensitive neuron). All 88 FBbt terms verified current against FBbt 2026-10-01. Expression recomputed for main + early (main rows byte-identical; 901,382 rows total; dataset total/filtered gene counts 15,754/7,473). Publication FBrf0247594 now resolved from VFB production (pdb). Gene ids mapped to current FlyBase genes (FB2026_03, FlyBase Chado; gene_id_map.tsv via scripts/update_gene_ids.py): 86 secondary ids -> current gene (3 merges, counts summed per cell), 1 split id and 1 withdrawn id (snRNA:U3) dropped, symbols refreshed; 901,382 expression rows; dataset total/filtered gene counts 15,751/7,473. 2026-10-14 (curator decision): clusters with no FBbt term (held) are no longer loaded - listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason, but given no VFBseq id (previously minted ids removed from the registry, never reused), no Cluster entity and no expression rows (their cells still count towards the Dataset's total/filtered gene counts, which measure what the experiment detected); 74 held clusters (12 main class C; 62 early: 58 class x, 4 class C) left out; 232 Clusters loaded (184 main, 48 early); expression 686,568 rows (dataset total/filtered gene counts 15,751 / 7,473, unchanged). 2026-10-15: Assays named "<Sample>, 10x lane <n> of <N>" (paper Methods: 4 Chromium lanes per W1118 sample, 8 per DGRP sample; one GSM per lane) (previously the accession or library id); ids unchanged.
